description: This file contains functions and types related to managing gateway installation tokens, including resolving, validating, and possibly auto-generating tokens, as well as handling configuration persistence and ambiguity in authentication modes.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredGatewayInstallToken
methods.description: Resolves the gateway install token from explicit input, config, or environment variables.

methods.name: validateGatewayInstallTokenSecretRef
methods.description: Validates that the secret reference for the gateway token is resolvable and non-empty.

methods.name: maybePersistAutoGeneratedGatewayInstallToken
methods.description: Attempts to persist an auto-generated token into the configuration file, with warnings if the config is invalid or token is managed via secret.

methods.name: formatAmbiguousGatewayAuthModeReason
methods.description: Formats a message explaining why the gateway auth mode configuration is ambiguous.

methods.name: resolveGatewayInstallToken
methods.description: Main function to resolve the gateway install token, handling various scenarios including secret references, auto-generation, and configuration persistence.
